question: Which Raman mode showed the largest mean red shift when the V2O5 film was prestrained, by how much, and which mode shifted the other way?
rendered: The V−O2 mode showed the largest mean red shift of 5 cm^−1 when the V2O5 film was prestrained. The V−O2 (∼303 cm^−1) mode showed a mean blue shift of 1 cm^−1.
